s05: 我觉得我们还处在早期
My sense is that we're in the early innings
这套新计算架构，才刚开始建
of the buildout of this new computing architecture.
如果眼里只有那么几家公司
And it's a real big mistake to recognize just a couple of companies
以为基建的钱全靠它们，那就大错特错了
and think that they're funding the infrastructure.
s07: 我一直很支持开源模型
I've been a great advocate of open models.
因为开源模型会打开新的机会
Open models open up new opportunities.
你看这些创业公司，八成都在用开源模型
Look at all these startups, 80% of them use open models.
他们不是拿它去跟前沿实验室竞争
They're not using it to compete with the frontier labs.
They're using it to unlock a new opportunity somewhere else.
s10: 同时，我们用得也越来越多
Meanwhile, our use of it has gone up
十年下来，大概涨了一百万倍
between 10 years ago and now — probably a million times.
我不觉得这个趋势会停
I don't think this trend is going to stop.
人们对智能的需求，几乎没有止境
There's a fairly insatiable demand for intelligence.
你越聪明，就越能想到智能还能用在哪儿
The smarter you are, the more ideas of applying intelligence you have.
s12: 从数字世界走到实体世界
When you move from digital to the physical,
there are a lot of obstacles.
There's power generation you've got to bring online.
还得有建筑工人、安装工、水管工
You need construction workers and outfitters and plumbers…
光是建这些，就多出上百万个工作岗位
Creating a million new jobs just building these things.
s15: 对齐会是个永远解决不完的问题
Alignment is going to be a forever problem.
如果非要等完美对齐才算安全
If we depend on perfect alignment in order to ensure safety,

s17: You start out with zero trust.
你招一个人，一开始也是零信任
When you hire somebody, you start out with zero trust.
一岁的小孩，你会把他放进游戏围栏
When you have a baby that's one year old, you put them in a playpen.
默认零信任，只给最小的权限
You assume zero trust. You give them minimum rights.
了解得越多，再一点点放宽边界
And you expand that boundary as you learn more.
